children.value: > Fact From Story: Google unveiled a new flagship AI model this week called Gemini.

> > Fact From Story: In a press briefing and blog posts, Google touted Gemini’s coding capabilities and multimodal prowess, claiming that the model can understand images, audio and videos just as well as text.
> > > Fact From Story: But it didn’t release the full model, Gemini Ultra — only a “lite” version called Gemini Pro.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Companies often release a smaller, less powerful version of the product before releasing the full version.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Companies tend to highlight the key features and capabilities of their new products during the unveiling.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Companies often announce and showcase their latest products to the public.
